# Health Tech Career Roadmaps
# https://roadmaps.ehoneahobed.com
# By Ehoneah Obed

> Research-backed career transition guides for healthcare professionals (nurses, pharmacists, clinicians) moving into health tech roles. Built by a pharmacist who made the switch.

## About This Site

This site contains comprehensive career roadmaps for mid-career healthcare professionals (30s+) in the US, UK, and Canada who are navigating AI disruption and considering strategic transitions into health tech. Each roadmap follows a standardized 7-section framework and is grounded in real job posting analysis, verified certifications, and published transition stories.

## Available Roadmaps

- /r/clinical-data-analyst: Clinical Data Analyst career transition roadmap (3 to 6 months, moderate difficulty)
- /r/health-informatics-analyst: Health Informatics Analyst career transition roadmap (3 to 6 months, moderate difficulty)
- /r/ehr-implementation-specialist: EHR Implementation Specialist career transition roadmap (1 to 3 months, low difficulty)
- /r/health-tech-product-manager: Health Tech Product Manager career transition roadmap (6 to 12 months, high difficulty)
- /r/healthcare-ai-ml-engineer: Healthcare AI/ML Engineer career transition roadmap (12 to 18 months, very high difficulty)
- /r/health-tech-regulatory-compliance-analyst: Health Tech Regulatory & Compliance Analyst career transition roadmap (4 to 8 months, moderate difficulty)
- /r/health-data-analyst: Health Data Analyst career transition roadmap (4 to 8 months, moderate difficulty)
- /r/healthcare-cybersecurity-analyst: Healthcare Cybersecurity Analyst career transition roadmap (6 to 12 months, high difficulty)
- /r/clinical-research-associate: Clinical Research Associate career transition roadmap (2 to 4 months, low difficulty)

## Roadmap Framework (7 Sections)

Each roadmap contains:
1. Role Snapshot: What the role involves, who is hiring, demand trends, and why clinical background is an advantage
2. What You Already Have: Clinical skill translations for nurses, pharmacists, and other clinicians
3. The Learning Path: Phased learning plan with specific free and paid resources, time estimates, and checkpoint deliverables
4. Certifications: Which certifications actually appear in job postings, categorized by signal strength
5. Portfolio Projects: Hands-on projects that demonstrate competence with clinical domain advantage
6. Real Transition Stories: Verified examples of healthcare professionals who made this exact transition
7. First Three Moves: Three specific actions to take this week to start the transition
